'''Talbina''' is a [[porridge]] made from [[barley flour]], formed by adding [[milk]] and [[honey]] to the dried barley powder. The name comes from the Arabic word {{Transliteration|ar|laban}} meaning milk, because of its resemblance to milk, as it is soft and white.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Definition of the words "Talbina" and "laban" in Lisan'ul Arab dictionary. |url=https://www.almaany.com/ar/dict/ar-ar/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A9/?c=%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%20%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%A8 |access-date= |website=Almaany}}</ref>
